description: Tools for UK businesses importing from China. Look up the UK commodity code and duty rate for a product, with a flag when China-specific anti-dumping or countervailing duty applies. Estimate duty, import VAT and landed cost. See which UK rules apply (UKCA or CE, toy safety, food contact, UK REACH, packaging). Work out how many containers a load needs, compare sea and air freight on total cost, and find the latest order date before the Chinese New Year factory shutdown. You can also search Cambridge China Bridge's import guides and, when you want help buying from a Chinese factory, send an enquiry to Cambridge China Bridge, a UK sourcing company with its own staff in China. An enquiry is only sent after you have seen and confirmed the details.

defaultPrompt: What UK import duty do I pay on ceramic tiles from China?
When is the last date to order from China to have stock in the UK before Chinese New Year?
Estimate the landed cost of £5,000 of LED lights from China with £600 shipping
